training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Same 25% color quartets, 25% navigation, 40% state calibration, 10% retained primitive schedule. State calibration uses one same-image quartet [v,-v,0,v/2] per microbatch; domains 25/25/50% and tasks 2..6 cycle. Common flow noise/time across the quartet; t=1 on even steps, sampled common time on odd steps. Other sampling unchanged.
training.loss: Flow matching on six normalized action channels, weights [8,8,1,1,1,1], divided by their sum; runtime units and normalization unchanged.
training.data: Same pixels, states, English prompts, sampling and navigation as train08. Only stationary horizontal teacher labels use -0.6 times captured estimated velocity, clipped to 0.2m/s; grounded takeoff stays zero.
training.frozen_backbone: All vision-language parameters; train action expert and state/action projections only. Verify frozen parameter digest before and after training.
training.image_domains: Explicit per-image domains; new views are appended after the 6408 existing image IDs.

teacher.scope: Training labels only; frozen velocity-to-attitude controller already subtracts current estimated velocity.
teacher.reason: Zero horizontal targets yielded insufficient physical hover duration in several completed jitter trials. Test mild learned braking rather than the earlier stronger 0.8/1.2 teacher coefficients. This is a training hypothesis, not a proven stability guarantee or a change to the runtime controller.
teacher.stationary_horizontal_command: -0.6 * input estimated horizontal velocity; vector norm <=0.2m/s; constant across 32 steps. Zero while unarmed or takeoff altitude <0.25m.

data.unchanged: All pixels, states, English prompts, splits, navigation/landing labels, nonhorizontal labels, runtime and scoring.

evaluation: Unchanged: dev 8/8; exposed stress >=14/16, >=7/8 each color, >=3/4 each layout; regression 5/5; known failure 1/1; then fresh matched 16 per model and preregistered static probe.
hypotheses_not_results: Mild braking learned from estimated velocity may improve settling after takeoff without the oscillation risk of stronger delayed corrections. Keep navigation and all nonhorizontal targets unchanged.
Detector failures and stability failures are separate from choosing the wrong color; full mission success, not component success, remains required.
All existing dev, stress, regression, known-failure, fresh paired and static intervention gates remain unchanged; final-step weights only.

design_review.reason: Full-suite review showed 7 initial-hover failures and prolonged drift during H15 hover (median physical speed about 0.110m/s with near-zero requested horizontal velocity). Choose 0.6 before any new training: a moderate correction below prior 0.8/1.2 teachers, while retaining train08 navigation. This is not a claim of an optimal or proven-stable gain.
design_review.caveat: These candidates also differ in training history/data. The counts are development evidence, not an isolated gain comparison.

resources.training: Windows GPU, no WSL training; no flight concurrent with training
resources.scope: Project WSL process tree only; other user workloads and global WSL settings untouched
